title: How Does the QB Hear the Play in His Helmet? #Shorts
description:
How does the quarterback hear the play call inside his helmet? The coach talks into a headset, a radio signal carries it to a tiny speaker by his ear, and it only goes one way. It cuts out automatically at 15 seconds on the play clock, and only the green dot player on each side gets one.

Explained in 60 #12

#ExplainedIn60 #HowThingsWork #Football #GameDay #Shorts
